statements.t: Our target sectors include natural resource monitoring, infrastructure analysis, agriculture, forestry, and defense and security applications.
Our product strategy is based on a common platform architecture intended to allow multiple applications to use shared structural, power, communications, control and payload-interface components.
We plan to introduce Sensus first, initially targeting water-quality, aquaculture, utility, and research applications in North America using probes supplied by third-party sensor manufacturers.
We expect WaveDrone XL and customer-specific configurations to be offered primarily on a request-for-quote basis.
Each WaveDrone is intended to connect to MoonTower Analytics, our fleet-management and mission-control software, which we currently plan to offer on a subscription basis.

Subject to successful development and testing and our ability to obtain sufficient financing, our current target is to complete during the fourth quarter of 2026 a functional WaveDrone prototype suitable for extended testing and performance benchmarking and to assemble demonstration equipment for prospective customers and channel partners.
During the first quarter of 2027, we currently intend to pursue initial commercial sales, reseller agreements and paid pilot programs.
During the second half of 2027 through 2028, we currently plan to continue development of additional WaveDrone configurations and payloads and our other planned product lines.
Based on our current development plan, management preliminarily estimates that this phase could require approximately $4 million to $6 million of development expenditures across our product lines.

Working capital at September 30, 2026, includes $1,415,768 of prepaid licensing assets that will be amortized to expense and are not available to satisfy current obligations; excluding those assets, we had a working capital deficit of $1,049,471.

Management has not concluded that these plans are probable of being effectively implemented within the relevant assessment period, and there can be no assurance that we will obtain additional funding or achieve profitability.
